analyst_view.overall: Fourth-placed Twente (24 pts) host bottom side Willem II, who have 3 points from 12 games, have conceded 40 goals and have not won in 29 Eredivisie matches; a draw or defeat would equal the league's worst winless run (Helmond Sport, 1983-84). Willem II sacked John Stegeman on 20 October and Jurgen Streppel has since lost 7-0 at PSV and drawn 1-1 with PEC Zwolle, while Twente come out of the break wanting to bounce back after dropping points at Fortuna and Utrecht last time and drawing 2-2 with Ajax on 8 November. Twente's Thorvaldsen, Bruns, Unnerstall and Lemkin are all still doubtful (25-50% in one injury tracker); the numbers only take a tiny amount off for Bruns. Willem II miss Hoogma and Lachkar, as the numbers know, and one tracker also lists winger Jaden Slory as suspended, which the numbers do not see. Serdar Gozubuyuk's high card rate is already a big part of the cards number.

goals.text: The numbers say 4.0 goals, already lifted for Twente's 21 goals in their last six and Willem II's 21 conceded. The only thing they can't see is Jaden Slory's suspension listed by one injury tracker, a small loss for a side that has scored 11 all season, so I trim Willem II's share slightly to about 3.9. Twente's doubtful attackers (Thorvaldsen, Bruns) returning would not change much, as the numbers barely took them off.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.8 corners, with Twente's 46 corners in their last six already counted and Willem II's low corner output too. Expect Twente to camp in Willem II's half against a side under a new coach that has conceded 40 goals; that one-sided pattern is exactly what the numbers already describe, so I stay at 10.8.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.1 cards, and Serdar Gozubuyuk's record (3.9 a game over 80 games) is already a +37% part of it, with Willem II's recent 12 cards in six also counted. A bottom side chasing a first win under Streppel could get stuck in, but that is the usual picture for a relegation side away at a top-four team; I add nothing and stay at 4.1.

shots.text: The numbers say 35.6 shots, already pushed up a lot (about +25%) for Twente's 145 shots in their last six. Willem II have been shelled recently (0-7 at PSV) and their own shooting is low, which is also counted. No lineup news points either way, so I stay at 35.6.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 11.2 shots on target, with Twente's recent accuracy already counted. Willem II's attack, already the weakest in the league, loses Slory to a suspension according to one tracker, so I shave their share a little to about 11.0.
